notes.title: Nominate Bread for the 2024 Steam Awards!
notes.content:
The [b]2024 Steam Awards[/b] are here, and we’d love your help to nominate Bread in some of the fun categories! While [i]Bread[/i] may be all about clicking bread, we think it’s a game worth celebrating, and here’s where you can nominate us:

[list]
[*] [b]Game of The Year Award[/b] – Who knew clicking bread could be this addictive?
[*] [b]Outstanding Visual Style Award[/b] – Our unique bread skins are quirky, fun, and unforgettable!
[*] [b]Most Innovative Gameplay Award[/b] – It’s simple, yet brilliantly fun. Who else thought of clicking bread?
[*] [b]Best Game You Suck At Award[/b] – It might look easy, but mastering the perfect click is an art.
[*] [b]Best Soundtrack Award[/b] – The relaxing tunes in Bread are perfect for an enjoyable gaming session.
[*] [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game Award[/b] – OK, Bread may not have a deep story, but it sure sparks a lot of imagination!
[*] [b]Sit Back and Relax Award[/b] – Few things are more calming than the simple joy of clicking bread.
[/list]

While you’re nominating [i]Bread[/i], don’t forget we’re offering a [b]50% discount[/b] during the Autumn Sale 2024! You can get the game for just [b]0,49€[/b], and our in-game items, like the adorable [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/3249680/detail/12/]Crumbs the Pet Pigeon[/url][/b], are also on sale for [b]1,40€[/b] (down from 2,85€).

Nominate [i]Bread[/i] before [b]December 4th[/b], and help us rise to the top of the Steam Awards! Thank you for your support and happy clicking!

notes.title: Introducing the 2024 Contributors' Bread
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of an exclusive bread skin for our most dedicated community members: the [b]2024 Contributors' Bread[/b]! This vibrant, multi-colored loaf is more than just a skin – it’s a symbol of appreciation for all those who’ve helped make the game even more fun and engaging.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218689/3e413869241b44eaf521a1a2c99d9cb1e80d3ab1.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How to Become Eligible[/b][/h2]

We want to reward players who go the extra mile to support Bread. To get your hands on this limited-edition loaf, you’ll need to contribute in one or more of the following ways:
[list]
[*][b]Create a Guide:[/b] You can create a variety of helpful guides for the community. Think of a tier list of the skins, or rank all the skins from worst to best – anything that helps players enjoy the game more! Other helpful guides could include achievement tips, strategies, or how to maximize your points per click.
[*][b]Share Screenshots:[/b] Upload your most creative or funny in-game moments to the Steam Community page. We love seeing what you come up with!
[*][b]Active Forum Participation:[/b] Be a positive force in our discussions! Whether you’re helping out with questions or sharing ideas, active members of the community will be recognized.
[*][b]Anything Else:[/b] The developer will be keeping an eye on all forms of contribution, whether big or small. If you’ve done something creative, helpful, or contributed to the game in any way, the [i]2024 Contributors' Bread[/i] may be yours!
[/list]
[i]Unfortunately, the Steam Workshop is not yet active, so custom skins cannot be uploaded at this time. However, we’re actively working on it, and we’re aiming to have it available for players to upload custom skins next year. Stay tuned![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How the Skin Will Be Delivered[/b][/h2]

The developer will be continuously monitoring players who contribute to the game. If you’ve helped in any way, they will reach out to you directly and send you a trade offer to claim your reward!
[hr][/hr]

Stay creative, stay awesome, and keep clicking that bread!

notes.title: Bread Just Got Stylish: Equip Your Loaf with Skins Now!
notes.content:
Big news, bread lovers! 🍞

The Bread game just got a major upgrade, and we're super excited to announce that you can now view your inventory and equip bread skins! Yeah, you heard that right. You can now dress your loaf in style, making it the trendiest slice in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218689/bf868eaa3c231ffa4b74688d9e01eae9bcbc55ae.png[/img]

[h2]What's the deal?[/h2]
Gone are the days of plain, boring bread. You’ve been clicking away like a pro, unlocking awesome skins—now you can actually equip them and show off your customized loaf! Whether it's a galaxy-themed bread or something as crazy as garlic bread (because why not?), it’s time to let your bread shine.

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]
It’s pretty simple, even simpler than baking bread (trust us on this one). Hop into the inventory, browse your collection of fabulous skins, and click "Equip" to give your bread a fresh look. That's it! Boom. You’re now the proud owner of the coolest loaf on the block.

[h2]Why care?[/h2]
Because bread has never looked this good, and you deserve to play with a stylish slice. Plus, who doesn’t want to flex with epic and rare skins while clicking away for points? Whether you’re going for the basic loaf look or something completely ridiculous like a space-themed bread, there’s a skin for every mood.

So what are you waiting for? Dive into your inventory, equip your favorite bread skin, and get clicking in style!

notes.title: Bread is Almost Here - Launching Next Week!
notes.content:
Hey, bread-loving clickers and dough dominators!

It’s finally happening — [b]Bread[/b] is baking its way to Steam NEXT WEEK! 🍞🚀 We've spent months perfecting the art of clicking bread, and now it’s your turn to join the carb-loaded fun.

[h2]What is Bread, you ask?[/h2]
The concept is simple: you click bread. But, oh boy, it’s so much more than that. With each click, you’ll gain points, unlock legendary achievements, and inch your way toward becoming the Ultimate Breadmaster. Whether you're earning the "[b]First Slice[/b]" for your first click or the mighty "[b]Toast Titan[/b]" for reaching 250 clicks, every tap brings you closer to bread greatness.

But we didn’t stop there—no, no! We’re excited to announce that skins are already dropping in the game! 🎨🖱️ Imagine a world where your bread doesn’t just look like a loaf — it could be a frothy beer mug, a dazzling rainbow loaf, or something equally ridiculous.

However, here’s the twist: while these glorious skins are already dropping like hotcakes (or hot bread?), you won’t be able to equip them just yet. The bread-skinning magic will unlock in a future update, so for now, consider these skins your future bread wardrobe. Hold onto them—they’ll come in handy later! 🥳

[h2]The Exclusive Breadiginal Event![/h2]
For those who dive into the dough early, we’ve got something extra special. Introducing the [b]Breadigina[/b]l: a one-of-a-kind bread that only drops within the first month after launch. That’s right, miss this window and you’ll never get a taste of this exclusive bread again! 🥖✨

And if that’s not enough, the first players to join the bread frenzy will be rewarded with the prestigious [b]Breadiginal Badge[/b], a permanent symbol of your early-bird dedication. Wear it with pride and let everyone know you were there from the very beginning, clicking bread before it was cool. 😎

[h2]Follow Us for Updates![/h2]
Keep up with all the fresh game updates, skin news, and patch drops by following us on Instagram, Twitter, and joining our ever-growing community on Discord. You don’t want to miss a single crumb of info!

[list]
[*] Instagram: @clickthebread
[*] Twitter: @ClickTheBread
[/list]
[h2]Ready. Set. Click. 🥖[/h2]
Next week, the bread awaits you. Steam is about to get a whole lot toastier!
